title: Evidence
description: Output of the Verifier (Stage 5). The MOST IMPORTANT schema for scoring: a verdict without evidence is discarded by the harness before anyone reads it. The Verifier fills verdict, criteria, regression, adversarial_findings, adversarial_attempted, handoff, unverifiable and failure_feedback_for_dev; the harness fills version, machine_gate, checklist_summary, scope_violation and canary.

version.description: Which verification attempt this is (1 = first). Filled by the harness, not the Verifier.

verdict.description: pass: every AC pass AND regression pass. fail: at least one AC fail (failure_feedback_for_dev then required). inconclusive: tests could not be run, or at least one AC is unclear.

machine_gate.description: Results of the machine gate (0 LLM) that runs BEFORE the Verifier. Filled by the harness; the Verifier only reads it.

coverage_delta.description: Coverage change in percentage points after the patch. Below -2 triggers a warning.

sast.description: SAST (bandit) on the changed files. fail ⇔ at least one HIGH finding. skipped when the tool is missing or no .py file changed. The summary carries high/medium/low counts.

coverage.description: pytest-cov + diff-cover. pass|skipped only, never fail. The measurements live in coverage_delta / coverage_total / uncovered_new_lines.

coverage_total.description: Whole-repo coverage percentage after the patch.

uncovered_new_lines.description: New or changed lines in the diff not executed by any test. Empty = good.

blast_radius.description: Blast radius of the patch (ast + CodeGraph impact + FMEA). Filled by the harness. risk is only a signal for the Leader / confidence, not a gate.

criteria.description: EXACTLY one entry per acceptance_criteria item in the spec, matched by id. A missing AC fails the schema.

evidence.description: Real command output (e.g. 'pytest ... 12 passed') OR a file:line reference. Prose such as 'looks correct' is NOT valid.

skip_reason.description: Required when ran=false: why the regression suite was not run.

adversarial_findings.description: The Verifier is TASKED with finding defects. An empty list is valid only when adversarial_attempted is non-empty.

location.description: Location of the finding as file:line.

adversarial_attempted.description: Attack angles the Verifier tried without finding a defect. Proves that a real review took place.

checklist_results.description: Results of the checklists from 35-checklists. The harness fills regex/test items, the Verifier fills diff_inspection/llm items. A failed blocking item forces verdict=fail.

id.description: Checklist item id, e.g. CODE-001, WEB-003, LRN-shop-services-001.

evidence.description: Required when result=fail: file:line or the regex hit.

checklist_summary.description: Aggregated by the harness for the dashboard, e.g. '27/30 ✓ · 1 major'.

machine_ratio.description: Share of items run by the harness with 0 LLM.

handoff.description: At most two sentences: what the next reader (Leader / human) needs to know that the artifact does not make obvious. See 70-human-control/07-rituals.

unverifiable.description: ACs that could not be verified by machine (e.g. need staging). The Leader / a human decides.

failure_feedback_for_dev.description: REQUIRED when verdict=fail. At most three sentences, pointing at file:line. This is the ONLY channel through which the Dev hears from the Verifier.

scope_violation.description: Files the Dev touched outside spec.allowed_files. Filled by the harness from the diff. Non-empty forces verdict=fail.

canary.description: Filled by the harness when this task carries a mutation canary. The Verifier does NOT know this field exists.

output_ref.description: artifact:// reference to the full log.

criteria.evidence: diff touches only src/api/users.py:42-58 (get_user) and tests/test_users.py; no other hunks

adversarial_attempted: negative id → still 404 (checked manually via pytest -k)
non-numeric id → the router validates first, never reaches the handler
race: could db.get() raise after an exists check? — no, there is only one call
